contribution.description: A participant supplied observations and interpretive distinctions that helped continue an informal public exchange into a bounded research trace concerning significance, style attribution, communication accommodation, and human-AI interaction.

qualified_examination.reconstruction_statement: The contribution was examined as an individual, domain-relevant input rather than treated as representative of a demographic group. Its distinctions were reconstructed into trace observations and candidate empirical work.
qualified_examination.qualification_basis: Bounded analysis against the repository's governed collaboration, trace-creation, attribution, and continuation role; no claim of academic credential, employment authority, or identity adjudication is made.

causal_effect.bounded_claim: The participant exchange materially supplied concepts represented in the trace, including participant-relative significance, consent-aware attribution, interaction-to-research continuation, and communication-accommodation hypotheses. This does not establish authorship of unrelated StegVerse work or authority outside this trace.
